definitions.explanation: The individual being discussed; the person in question.

examples.japanese: {本人|ほんにん}に{直接|ちょくせつ}{聞|き}いてください。
{本人|ほんにん}{確認|かくにん}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
{本人|ほんにん}は{何|なに}も{知|し}らないようだ。
examples.english: The person himself seems to know nothing.

examples.japanese: {本人|ほんにん}の{同意|どうい}がなければ、{個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}を{他人|たにん}に{教|おし}えてはいけない。
examples.english: You must not share personal information with others without the person's consent.

examples.japanese: {周|まわ}りはみんな{心配|しんぱい}しているのに、{本人|ほんにん}は{全然|ぜんぜん}{気|き}にしていない。
examples.english: Everyone around is worried, but the person himself doesn't seem bothered at all.

notes:
USAGE: {本人|ほんにん} emphasizes that you're referring to the actual person involved, not someone else on their behalf.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{本人|ほんにん}に (to the person himself)
・{本人|ほんにん}から (from the person himself)
・{本人|ほんにん}{確認|かくにん} (identity verification)
・{本人|ほんにん}の{意思|いし} (the person's own will)
・{本人|ほんにん}{不在|ふざい} (the person not being present)

CONTRAST:
・{本人|ほんにん} (the person himself)
・{代理人|だいりにん} (representative, proxy)
